selection: All frozen independent January airport-hour windows; group size from 16 donor dates only; unique physical release limits N, ceil(N/4), ceil(N/8); exclude donor-incomplete combinations before solving
smoke_selection: First chronological window at every distinct release limit plus first and largest-group N/4 windows at each airport, both response times
physical_service_clipping: Count capped at group size; leaves cumulative takeoffs unchanged for releases <= N
numerical_deduplication: Identical service calendars, group size, travel, release limit and response time count once
